explain.deloadApplied: Applied a deload week: less volume and slightly lighter loads.
explain.equipmentChanged: Rebuilt the program around the equipment you now have.
explain.goalChanged: Rebuilt the program for your new goal.
explain.manualEdit: You edited this program by hand.
explain.programCreated: Program created from your goals, schedule and equipment.
explain.scheduleChanged: Rebuilt the week around your new training days.
explain.volumeIncreased: Increased %@ volume based on your recovery and recent performance.
explain.volumeReduced: Reduced %@ volume because recent sessions and recovery feedback suggested it was too much.
programming.balance: Push and pull volume are balanced across the week.
programming.cardio.afterLifting: %lld conditioning block(s) a week, placed after your lifting as you asked.
programming.cardio.separate: %lld conditioning session(s) a week, kept separate from your lifting as you asked.
programming.extended: %lld set(s) were added because your sessions had time to spare.
programming.fallback.bodyweight: Some slots fall back to bodyweight exercises, because nothing else in your equipment fits them.
programming.fallback.group: Some muscle groups are trained indirectly, because your equipment cannot reach them directly.
programming.priority: %lld muscle group(s) you prioritised get extra sets and an earlier slot in the session.
programming.rationale.accessory: Accessory work to finish the muscle off once the heavy lifting is done.
programming.rationale.cardio: Conditioning, placed after lifting so it does not blunt your strength work.
programming.rationale.core: Core work, kept to the end so it does not compromise your bracing on the big lifts.
programming.rationale.locked: You locked this exercise, so it stays exactly where you put it.
programming.rationale.primary: The main lift for this muscle, placed first while you are freshest.
programming.rationale.priority: Extra work for a muscle group you asked to prioritise.
programming.rationale.secondaryCompound: A second compound to add volume from a different angle.
programming.rationale.substituteGroup: A stand-in for a muscle group your available equipment cannot train directly.
programming.trimmed: %lld set(s) were removed so each session fits inside your %lld-minute limit.
programming.volume: Around %lld hard sets a week for each major muscle group.
programming.volume.age: Volume is set a little more conservatively to leave more room for recovery.
programming.volume.deload: This is a deload week, so volume is deliberately reduced.
programming.volume.fatigue: Volume is trimmed slightly because your recent sessions and check-ins suggest you are still recovering.
programming.volume.timeCapped: Volume is capped by the time you have: %lld sessions of up to %lld minutes.
split.reason.activeRecovery: Six hard days is the practical ceiling, so the %lldth is light conditioning and core work.
split.reason.fourWay: A four-way split across %lld days: enough sessions to separate the heavy work from the accessory work.
split.reason.fullBody: Full-body sessions %lld times a week: with this many days, training every muscle each session gives each one the most frequency.
split.reason.posteriorEmphasis: A posterior-chain-led split across %lld days: your back, glutes and hamstrings get the first, freshest session of the cycle.
split.reason.pplUpperLower: Push, pull and legs plus an upper/lower block across %lld days: it fits a second pass at every muscle into the week.
split.reason.pushPullLegs: Push, pull and legs across %lld days: grouping muscles that work together means less overlap between sessions and more recovery for each.
split.reason.specialisation: A %lld-day split with a dedicated day for the muscles you want to prioritise.
split.reason.torsoArmsLegs: Torso, shoulders and arms, then legs across %lld days: it gives the smaller muscles their own session instead of tacking them onto a long one.
split.reason.upperLower: An upper/lower split across %lld days: it hits every muscle twice a week while keeping each session a sensible length.
split.reason.upperLowerFull: Upper, lower and a full-body day across %lld days: the extra full-body session tops up frequency without adding a fourth training day.
